recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. The change is limited to active NamingSystem terminology and operation wording and aligns implementer-facing text with the published FHIR-24663 decision without changing operation signatures or introducing new terminology policy.
issue_request: FHIR-24663 was Published/Persuasive for R5 and requested adding v2csmnemonic to the namingsystem-identifier-type CodeSystem and associated ValueSet for HL7 Version 2 table 0396 code system identifiers.
initial_application: Commit 25159ea161eaed360cf05d040c52d38e80cdcbac, a bulk R5 NamingSystem change that explicitly listed FHIR-24663, added v2csmnemonic to source/namingsystem/codesystem-namingsystem-identifier-type.xml. The ValueSet composes all codes from that CodeSystem, and NamingSystem.uniqueId.type short text includes v2csmnemonic. However, the same source still contained stale wording that treated v2 table 0396 mnemonics as examples of the other identifier type.
additional_context: NamingSystem is active in source/fhir.ini, and the edited CodeSystem, StructureDefinition, and OperationDefinition files are active source under source/namingsystem. FHIR-26837 and FHIR-27136 explain the neighboring operation text but do not preserve the stale other wording. Vocab block-vote evidence and Jira/community searches found no later decision reversing v2csmnemonic or assigning table 0396 mnemonics back to other.
reconciliation: Changed the v2csmnemonic definition to fix copied typos, removed the v2 table 0396 example from the other identifier type, clarified NamingSystem.uniqueId.type so other covers identifiers not handled by more specific codes, and updated $preferred-id and $translate-id descriptions to call v2 table 0396 values code system mnemonics rather than other codes.
source_changes: source/namingsystem/codesystem-namingsystem-identifier-type.xml: corrected the v2csmnemonic definition and changed the other definition so it no longer examples HL7 v2 table 0396 mnemonics.
source/namingsystem/structuredefinition-NamingSystem.xml: clarified NamingSystem.uniqueId.type comments so other means identifier types not covered by specific codes.
source/namingsystem/operationdefinition-NamingSystem-preferred-id.xml: removed the stale '(other)' description for v2 table 0396 identifiers.
source/namingsystem/operationdefinition-NamingSystem-translate-id.xml: removed the stale '(other)' description for v2 table 0396 identifiers.

related_jiras.note: Added NamingSystem $translate-id, whose description uses the same NamingSystem identifier type vocabulary and needed alignment with v2csmnemonic rather than other.
Updated $preferred-id documentation around v2 table 0396 identifiers but did not decide to keep v2 mnemonics under the other code.
